I have only 0.08 hectares for my root crops, so I will put manure from our goats and chickens on this plot to help the soil, but I cannot buy chemical fertilizer for it when my maize needs that money more. I will plant improved cuttings because the extension worker in Lilongwe gave us good varieties last season, and since the plot is small, my children and I can manage all the work ourselves without paying anyone. We depend on the rains and will not use any sprays because these crops grow fine without chemicals.
